mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_session(session_id, user_id, username, title, msg_count, create_time) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{title}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, user_id, username, title, msg_count, create_time, update_time FROM agent_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_session SET title = #{title} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND (title IS NULL OR title = '')
UPDATE agent_session SET msg_count = msg_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_message(session_id, role, content, create_time) VALUES(#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
